title: Beyond Random Flips: Feature-Aware Label Poisoning for Targeted Attacks in Federated Learning
authors: **J. Saleem**, U. Rashid, I. Javed, H. Anwaar
summary: An attacker flips labels toward classes that already look similar, like cat to dog. The damage lands on chosen classes and looks like natural confusion, so it is harder to catch.
keyResult: Errors concentrate on one target class and get flagged less often than random flips
